SELECT sc.id, sc.name, sc.code, sc.icon_url AS iconUrl, sc.sort_no AS sortNo, sc.status, sc.description, sc.created_at AS createdAt, sc.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM scenic_category sc WHERE 1 = 1
AND sc.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{scenicCategory.name},'%')
AND sc.code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{scenicCategory.code},'%')
AND sc.status = #{scenicCategory.status}
ORDER BY sc.sort_no ASC
